column1: CHAPTER 11 Aggregate Demand I: Building the IS–LM Model | 335 5. The IS–LM model combines the elements of the Keynesian cross and the elements of the theory of liquidity preference. The IS curve shows the points that satisfy equilibrium in the goods market, and the LM curve shows the points that satisfy equilibrium in the money market. The intersection of the IS and LM curves shows the interest rate and income that satisfy equilibrium in both markets for a given price level.
